question: A major portion of 'Sufed Koh' mountain range lies in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Pakistan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Safed Koh mountain range on the Pakistan-Afghanistan border**, SE of Kabul; rises to 15,620 ft (4,761 m) at Mt. Sikaram.
 
• It parallels the Kabul River. A spur of the range is crossed by the Khyber Pass.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Karakoram:**

 
 
• It is a large mountain range spanning the border between Pakistan, India, and China.
 
• It is located in the regions of Gilgit Baltistan (Pakistan), Ladakh (India), and Xinjiang (China).
 
• The range is having many peaks such as k2 Mount Godwin Austen (8611m), the second-highest peak in the world, and three other peaks like Gasherbrum |(8068 m), Broad peak (8047 m), Gasherbrum II (8035 m).
 
 
 
• **Ladakh range:**
 
 
• It lies to the north of the Leh and is an important part of the trans- Himalayan range.
 
• It merges with the Kailash range in Tibet.
 
• The important passes are Khardung la and Digar la.
 
 
 
• **Zaskar range:**
 
 
• It covers an area of 7000 sq km and has a height between 3500-7000 m.
 
• It separates Zaskar from Ladakh to the northeast. Pir Panjal is a group of mountains in the inner Himalayan region running from east-southeast to west-northwest.
 
• It consists of the area of Himachal Pradesh, Jammu, and Kashmir and Pakistan administered Kashmir.
 
• It has passes such as Pir Panjal pass, Banihal pass, Sinthan pass and Rohtang la pass.
